idea-plugin.name: Go Project Support
idea-plugin.description:
Go support for IntelliJ-based IDEs that have none, built on the tools of the Go ecosystem:
  • gopls for errors, completion, navigation and refactorings (the LSP client of the platform)
  • delve behind the Debug button (the DAP client of the platform)
  • the go command: build, vet, run, test with a test tree, modules and their dependencies
  • gofmt / goimports behind Reformat Code
  • syntax highlighting, Structure view, folding, Go to Symbol that work without any tool
